_instructions: Team milestone timeline. Entries are shown chronologically. 'type' can be 'award', 'event', 'milestone', or 'outreach'.

milestones.title: Team Founded
milestones.description: Nova Pyra 25619 is founded at Mandeville Junior High — a revival of robotics inspired by the myth of Prometheus and the sister team of FRC S.S. Prometheus.

milestones.title: Into the Deep Season Kickoff
milestones.description: Rookie season begins at the FTC Louisiana INTO THE DEEP kickoff event in Denham Springs, LA.

milestones.title: FTC Louisiana Qualifier 1
milestones.description: Rookie debut at Hammond High Magnet School. Finished rank #6 with a 3-3-0 record and earned the Innovate Award.

milestones.title: FTC Louisiana Qualifier 2
milestones.description: Competed at Walker High School. Finished rank #6 with a 4-2-0 record and earned the Innovate Award.

milestones.title: Louisiana State Champions
milestones.description: Won the Think Award and the Louisiana Regional Championship in our rookie season, qualifying for the FIRST Championship.

milestones.title: NOLA STEM Fest
milestones.description: Represented Nova Pyra at the New Orleans STEM Festival alongside FIRST and other FTC teams, developing new connections across the engineering and robotics community.

milestones.title: Northshore Knockout
milestones.description: Competed at Mandeville High School and reached out to the FRC community, spreading awareness of FTC and recruiting for the upcoming season alongside sister team FRC S.S. Prometheus.

milestones.title: DECODE Season Kickoff
milestones.description: Second season begins at the FTC Louisiana DECODE kickoff event in Denham Springs, LA.

milestones.title: DDG & Intralox Facility Tours
milestones.description: Toured DDG headquarters and the Intralox engineering facility in Hammond, LA to explore real-world engineering processes and STEM career paths. DDG became a key sponsor through mentor Brad Villemeur.

milestones.title: LATM/LSTA Teacher Conference
milestones.description: Attended the Louisiana teacher convention at Raising Cane's Baton Rouge River Center to discuss STEM mentoring opportunities and grow the FIRST Pipeline across Louisiana.

milestones.title: STEM Nights at MES & PES
milestones.description: Hosted STEM Nights at Mandeville Elementary and Pontchartrain Elementary schools to introduce students and teachers to the FIRST community and recruit new teams.

milestones.title: FTC Louisiana Qualifier 1
milestones.description: DECODE season debut at Northshore High School. Finished rank #2 with a 5-1-0 record.

milestones.title: FTC Louisiana Qualifier 3
milestones.description: Competed at The Dunham School in Baton Rouge. Finished rank #1 with a perfect 6-0-0 record.

milestones.title: PES Out of this World STEAM Night
milestones.description: Outreach event at Pontchartrain Elementary School ahead of the Regional Championship.

milestones.title: Scrimmage — St. Thomas Aquinas High School
milestones.description: Drive team competed in mock-game matches at St. Thomas Aquinas High School with FTC teams 23264, 30727, and 18380, sharpening competition readiness before State.

milestones.title: Back-to-Back Regional Champions
milestones.description: Won the Innovate Award and served as Winning Alliance Captain at the FTC Louisiana Regional Championship for the second consecutive year. Finished rank #2 with a 5-1-0 record.

milestones.title: FIRST Championship — DECODE
milestones.description: Competed at FIRST Championship in our 2nd season, finishing rank #17 in Jackson Division.

milestones.title: FIRST Championship — Design Award
milestones.description: Received the Design Award (3rd Place) at FIRST Championship.
